verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain's own docs say it can generate SBOMs with a complete inventory of open source components, backed by dependency resolution through manifest parsing. The evidence never names the output format (SPDX or CycloneDX), never mentions container images, and has no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented SPDX/CycloneDX output formats, SBOM generation for container images, CLI/API workflow details for exporting the SBOM, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image

citations.quote: Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components
Supply Chain's Dynamic Dependency Resolution provides a complete inventory of your project's dependencies using a combination of manifest parsing and repository integration
